existing_tips: After numbers and `beaucoup/peu/assez`, `en` is required: `j'en ai trois` (I have three [of them]).
S'asseoir: elles se sont assises. Irregular with feminine plural agreement.
In negation, the pronoun stays before the verb: ne + pronoun + verb + pas.
In passé composé, reflexive verbs use être: elle s'est habillee. The participle agrees with the subj
Se promener = to take a walk. Nous nous promenons: first nous is subject, second is reflexive pronou
Finir par = to end up doing something. Par introduces the eventual outcome.
`en` = 'of it / of them / some' – replaces `de + noun` or a quantity. `Tu veux du café? Oui, j'en ve
'Par' with passive construction: 'construite par mon grand-père'. Note agreement: construite (femini
Lui is an indirect object pronoun meaning to him or to her. Placed before the verb.
